outputs.explanation: Panel A is a macroscopic photograph of intestines, not a plot showing averaged data.
Panel B is a histological micrograph (H&E staining), not a plot.

Panel C contains a box plot (exempt, distribution already shown) plus a 3D bar chart of mean polyp number per diameter category per genotype. The bar chart shows averaged/aggregated values across n=8–18 mice per genotype without overlaid individual data points, so the underlying variability cannot be assessed.
Panel D is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve (line plot), which is exempt from requiring individual data point overlay.
The bar graph quantifying GTP-bound Rac1 and Cdc42 shows mean relative values with error bars but no individual data points overlaid, despite representing averaged/normalized data across replicates.
Panel F consists of immunohistochemistry micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
The 'Relative expression' bar graph (Asef, pJNK1, MMP9 quantification with significance stars) shows mean values with error bars but does not display the individual underlying data points.
